title: 第1498章 混沌球带来的惊喜加更第1497章 资源来自混沌球
content_zh:
第1498章混沌球带来的惊喜（加更）
秦延军在初始星台上的修行，不知经历了多少岁月。混沌元气滋养着他的体魄与神魂。
混沌球之灵的指点让他一次次突破瓶颈，从一个重伤垂死的古神王，成长为一位在混沌海中都能掀起波澜的强者。
他对初始星台的每一寸土地都了如指掌，对混沌球的运用也达到了心随意动的境界。
然而，无论修为多高，对子女的思念始终是他心中最柔软的牵挂，也是他离开这里最坚定的动力。
他知道，孩子们还在二十八重天的世界里等着他，他留下的混沌青莲子，既是希望，也是他感知他们方位的唯一线索。
随着修为日深，秦延军对混沌球的理解也越发透彻。
他发现，初始星台并非完全封闭，它更像是混沌球内部开辟出的一方小天地，与外界混沌海有着某种微妙的联系。而要离开这里，关键便在混沌球本身。
一日，当他再次向混沌球之灵请教离开之法时，混沌球散发出柔和的光芒，一道信息传入他的识海：“星台为锚，混沌为舟，莲子为引，方能归航。非至混沌道体小成，不可强行。”
秦延军心中一凛，原来离开的条件如此苛刻。
他立刻明了，“星台为锚”是指需要以初始星台的本源之力为根基；“混沌为舟”便是以混沌球为媒介，穿梭混沌海；而“莲子为引”，正是他当初送出的那枚混沌青莲子！
他不再犹豫，开始冲击“混沌道体小成”之境。
这是一个痛苦而漫长的过程，他的肉身、经脉、神魂都在混沌能量的冲刷下不断破碎、重组、升华。
混沌球之灵在关键时刻，化作一道清光融入他的眉心，助他勘破最后一层壁垒。
“轰！”
当秦延军再次睁开双眼时，他的眼眸中仿佛有混沌生灭，周身气息收敛到极致，却又蕴含着毁天灭地的力量。混沌道体，小成！
他站起身，走到初始星台的中央，那里是与混沌球联系最紧密的地方。
他双手结印，引动整个初始星台的混沌元气，灌注于混沌球中。混沌球悬浮在他头顶，滴溜溜旋转，散发出前所未有的璀璨光芒。
“以我道体为基，以混沌球为舟，莲子为气息引，定位——二十八重天！”秦延军一声低喝，将自身对混沌青莲子的那丝微弱感应，无限放大，注入混沌球内。
混沌球猛地爆发出一股难以想象的吸力，将秦延军整个人包裹进去。

初始星台剧烈震动，仿佛要被抽走所有力量。
下一刻，混沌球化作一道流光，撕裂了初始星台的空间壁垒，消失在无尽的混沌深处。
在混沌球内部的空间里，秦延军并未感到丝毫颠簸。他能清晰地看到外界混沌气流的狂暴。
而混沌球则像一艘最完美的航船，自动规避着危险，沿着那丝微弱的莲子气息，高速穿梭。
就在这时，混沌球之灵的声音再次响起，带着一丝欣慰：“恭喜宿主，踏出混沌囚笼。作为奖励，混沌球将开启‘世界投影’与‘时空锚点’功能。”
content_en:
Chapter 1498 The surprise brought by the Chaos Ball (more updates)
Qin Yanjun's cultivation on the Initial Star Platform lasted for an unknown number of years. Chaos energy nourishes his body and soul.
The guidance of the Chaos Ball Spirit allowed him to break through bottlenecks time and time again, growing from a seriously injured and dying ancient god king to a strong man who could make waves in the sea of ​​chaos.
He knows every inch of the initial star platform like the back of his hand, and his use of the Chaos Ball has reached the level of freedom.
However, no matter how high his cultivation level is, the longing for his children is always the softest concern in his heart and the strongest motivation for him to leave here.
He knew that the children were still waiting for him in the world of the twenty-eighth heaven. The chaotic green lotus seeds he left behind were both hope and the only clue for him to sense their location.
As his cultivation deepened, Qin Yanjun's understanding of the Chaos Ball became more and more thorough.
He discovered that the initial star platform was not completely closed. It was more like a small world opened up inside the chaotic ball, and had some subtle connection with the external chaotic sea. The key to leaving here lies in the Chaos Ball itself.
One day, when he asked the spirit of the Chaos Ball again for advice on how to leave, the Chaos Ball emitted a soft light, and a message was transmitted into his sea of consciousness: "The star platform is the anchor, the chaos is the boat, and the lotus seeds are the guide, so that we can return home. You cannot force it until you have reached a small level of Chaos Dao Body."
Qin Yanjun was shocked because the conditions for leaving were so harsh.
He immediately understood that "the star platform is the anchor" means that the original power of the initial star platform is needed as the foundation; "chaos is the boat" means using the chaos ball as the medium to travel through the sea of ​​chaos; and "the lotus seed is the guide" is the chaotic green lotus seed he sent out originally!
He no longer hesitated and began to attack the realm of "Chaos Dao Body Small Accomplishment".
This is a painful and long process. His body, meridians, and soul are constantly broken, reorganized, and sublimated under the wash of chaotic energy.
At the critical moment, the spirit of the Chaos Ball turned into a clear light and blended into his eyebrows, helping him break through the last layer of barriers.
"Boom!"
When Qin Yanjun opened his eyes again, there seemed to be chaos in his eyes, and the aura around him was extremely restrained, but it still contained the power to destroy the world. Chaos Dao Body, Xiaocheng!
He stood up and walked to the center of the initial star platform, which was the place most closely connected with the Chaos Ball.
He formed seals with his hands, activating the chaotic energy of the entire initial star platform and pouring it into the chaos ball. The Chaos Ball was suspended above his head, spinning and emitting an unprecedented bright light.
"Using my Dao body as the base, the chaos ball as the boat, the lotus seeds as the breath guide, positioning - the twenty-eighth heaven!" Qin Yanjun shouted, infinitely amplifying his weak sense of the chaotic green lotus seeds and injecting it into the chaos ball.
The chaos ball suddenly erupted with an unimaginable suction force, enveloping Qin Yanjun's entire body.
The initial star platform shook violently, as if all its power was being drained away.
The next moment, the chaos ball turned into a stream of light, tearing apart the space barrier of the initial star platform and disappearing into the endless depths of chaos.
In the space inside the chaos ball, Qin Yanjun did not feel the slightest bump. He could clearly see the violent chaotic airflow outside.
The Chaos Ball is like the most perfect ship, automatically avoiding danger and traveling at high speed along the faint breath of lotus seeds.
At this moment, the voice of the Chaos Ball Spirit sounded again, with a hint of relief: "Congratulations to the host, stepping out of the Chaos Cage. As a reward, the Chaos Ball will activate the 'World Projection' and 'Time and Space Anchor' functions."
